summary: Keep the persisted cookie jar when a stored browser session exists, even if an env credential is set.
reason: Config.UsePersistedCookieJar() returns false whenever AuthSource begins with env:, which discarded the stored claysession the moment CLAY_API_KEY was exported. Because the documented setup exports that variable, the default state broke every app-API command.
validated_outcome: Verified live: workspace read succeeds with both credentials present; fails without the patch.
